note: Buena Vista County Conservation park at 377 440th Street, 4 mi west of Linn Grove on C13, on the wooded north slope of the Little Sioux valley: Timber Ridge (full hookups) and Bur Oak (water/electric) campgrounds plus primitive camping, hiking trails, arboretum, sledding hill and playground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: Bur Oak 12 water/electric $20, Timber Ridge 23 full-hookup $25, 20/30/50-amp, showers, dump, primitive $10. Season added (May 1-Oct 1). Not waterfront confirmed: the Little Sioux is out of sight beyond a field and wooded bottomland.
flags: WATERFRONT OK (not waterfront): the campground loop sits on the valley's wooded north slope above C13; south of the road is a crop field (NAIP shows it plowed; the dark band on winter Esri is that field, not water), and the Little Sioux runs farther south behind wooded bottomland, out of sight. The stored evidence ('county road between sites and river') is right that the road is between.

BOOKING (not changed): the stored first come, first served (derived from the note) isn't stated on the page, but MyCountyParks lists no campsites for booking (only the North Lodge, Oak Cabin and South Shelter House), which fits.
PHONE MISSING: Buena Vista County Conservation office 712-295-7985 (on the park page).
FIT UNCLEAR, keep: no pad lengths posted for either loop.
